name: kapelle
description: Human-controlled SDLC harness with deterministic schema and approval gates, bounded architecture design, adaptive feature delivery, and evidence-backed reconstruction.

interface.longDescription: A human-controlled SDLC harness with fail-closed JSON Schema validation, bounded high-level architecture design, pure deterministic fingerprinted approval gates that never edit artifacts, adaptive feature delivery, progressive specifications, recoverable state, and evidence-backed reconstruction of existing behavior and architecture.
defaultPrompt: Start a new feature from my raw task with Kapelle.
Plan a small feature through Kapelle's fast lane.
Expand and review a feature business specification with Kapelle.
Plan and implement a feature with human checkpoints.
Show or recover a feature status with Kapelle.
Amend an in-progress feature safely with Kapelle.
Migrate an older Kapelle feature to the current workflow.
Reconstruct an existing feature's product behavior and as-built architecture from code evidence.
